==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I walk up a flight of stairs alongside family and friends. At the top of the stairs is supposed to be a family reunion event. When I suddenly find myself in the middle of a basketball court, I become lucid.

The scene changes to a purple, liquid dimension. I feel at peace and can taste tea. I enjoy this for a moment, before willing the scene to change.

I transform myself into an angel and fly above New Orleans. I listen to jazz music from the streets below and watch a steamboat take off at the docks. I feel the need to go to the bathroom, so I wake myself up to go to the restroom.
